title: Hazelnut-Flavored Wrapped Turkish Dried Cherries Tagine
description: A unique and exotic Turkish dish featuring hazelnut-flavored dough wrapped around dried cherries, steamed to perfection in a ceramic tagine vessel.
instructions: Combine yeast, sugar, and warm water to activate yeast. Let it sit for 5 minutes, until frothy.
Add flour, mix until a shaggy dough forms. Knead for 5 minutes, until smooth.
Add ground hazelnuts and continue kneading for another 2 minutes.
Cover the dough with plastic wrap and let it rise for 1 hour, until doubled in size.
Divide the dough into 4 equal pieces. Roll each piece into a ball and flatten into a disk shape.
Place a tablespoon of chopped dried cherries in the center of each disk. Fold the dough over the cherries, forming a triangle or a square shape.
Place the wrapped cherries in a preheated ceramic tagine vessel, seam-side down.
Cover the tagine with a lid and steam for 20 minutes, until the dough is cooked through and fluffy.
Serve warm, dust with powdered sugar if desired.
